verdict.rationale: ElevenLabs publishes a first-party API reference for the Scribe convert endpoint with detailed parameter documentation (diarization threshold, timestamps granularity, webhooks, multichannel, export formats). Nothing in the evidence shows it is interactive or offers runnable examples. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it console or playground, runnable code examples in the reference, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the reference experience.
